title: Drilling Notice Periods, Charges and Contents Holding for Safe Deposit Boxes
content:
Where rent on Safe Deposit Boxes stays unpaid, the lease may end in the forced opening of the box. The notice periods, the charge for the opening and the terms on which the contents are afterwards held are set out below.

## Periods and method, all sizes alike

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Days after the rent due date at which the drilling notice is mailed | 120 days |
| Calendar days between the drilling notice and the earliest drilling date | 30 calendar days |
| How the drilling notice is sent | certified mail |
| Months drilled contents are held before being reported to the state unclaimed property program | 12 months |
| Charge to retrieve contents held after drilling | $50.00 |

## Charge for the forced opening, by size

| Size | Drilling charge |
| --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | $225.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | $225.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | $250.00 |

The charge for retrieving contents held after a drilling is $50.00 whatever the size of the box that was opened, and the holding period of 12 months likewise does not vary with size; only the charge for the opening itself does, taking three values across the six sizes.

**The two periods read together.** Where the drilling notice is mailed on the day this schedule names, it is mailed 120 days after the rent due date, and the earliest date on which the box may then be opened falls a further 30 calendar days later, that is 150 calendar days after the rent due date.
